cardOverview.overviewText: A First Classic entry-level card offering basic rewards on shopping and dining, crafted for first-time credit cardholders.

benefitRows.name: Dining
benefitRows.offer: Get a discount of upto 20% on dining across over 1,500 restaurants.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the dining partner’s platform using your registered account. Browse available dining and order-in offers, select your meals or restaurants, and apply the offer at payment. Use your IDFC First Classic credit card to unlock savings on dining bills.

benefitRows.name: District
benefitRows.offer: You get a 25% discount on movies (Upto ₹100) once every month, on the District app.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the District app once every month. Book movie tickets and apply your IDFC First Classic credit card at checkout to get 25% discount (up to ₹100). For assistance, contact IDFC FIRST Bank customer care at 1860 267 3333.
